def.label: missile rack
def.note: 16b cut AE.2's numbers. 250 m/s: a shot at the edge of a sight, 600 m, is 2.4 s in the air, and one on a teammate's plot at 900 m 3.6 s. The impact re-validates within one cell of where the target was, so a machine on the move (a stock tank on the grass makes 2.8 cells in 2.4 s) walks out from under it, and one that has stopped (a machine holding a square, a range target, a hulk) takes 350. The round is traced from where it was fired, so the shooter may move once it is away. Inside 600 m the cone is 12 mrad, because a rack does not aim the way a gun does; the 2 mrad band past it is a shared plot's. The outer edge is the cannon's 3 km on purpose: tempo.alert_range_cm is derived from the longest reach fielded.
